gloss: to sightsee; to watch; to go see

definitions.gloss: to sightsee; to go see (a sight or attraction)
definitions.explanation: To visit and look at places of interest, tourist attractions, or notable sights.

definitions.gloss: to watch; to be a spectator
definitions.explanation: To watch an event, performance, or scene as an onlooker.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}の{お寺|おてら}を{見物|けんぶつ}した。
examples.english: I went sightseeing at the temples in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{名所|めいしょ}を{見物|けんぶつ}しに{行|い}こう。
examples.english: Let's go see the famous cherry blossom spots.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{最終日|さいしゅうび}に{市内|しない}の{歴史的|れきしてき}な{建物|たてもの}を{見物|けんぶつ}して{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: On the last day of the trip, I went around sightseeing the historic buildings in the city.

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}りを{見物|けんぶつ}する。
{大勢|おおぜい}の{見物人|けんぶつにん}がパレードを{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: A large crowd of spectators was watching the parade.

examples.japanese: {花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}を{見物|けんぶつ}するために{早|はや}くから{場所取|ばしょと}りをした。
examples.english: I went early to claim a spot to watch the fireworks festival.

notes:
Composed of {見|けん} (see, look) + {物|ぶつ} (thing). Used both as a suru verb ({見物|けんぶつ}する) and as a noun ({見物|けんぶつ}). Has a slightly old-fashioned or traditional tone compared to {観光|かんこう}する for tourism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見物|けんぶつ}に{行|い}く: to go sightseeing
- {見物|けんぶつ}して{回|まわ}る: to go around seeing the sights
- {見物人|けんぶつにん}: spectator, onlooker
- {見物客|けんぶつきゃく}: sightseer, tourist
- {花見|はなみ}{見物|けんぶつ}: cherry blossom viewing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {観光|かんこう}する: to do tourism, to sightsee — more modern and commonly used for tourism
- {観覧|かんらん}する: to view, to watch — more formal, used for organized viewings
- {見学|けんがく}する: to tour, to observe — educational or inspective purpose
